By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and laws of the  
United States of America, and in order to amend Executive Order No. 12334, it  
is hereby ordered that the second sentence of section 1 of Executive Order No.  
12334 shall be deleted and the following sentence inserted in lieu thereof:  
“One member shall be designated by the President as Chairman.”

operative_clauses.judgment_reason: The whole order is one self-executing strike-and-insert amendment of section 1 of EO 12334; the text sets no later effective date, so it was complete on signing, February 14, 1990. It states no "until" date or deadline. Under the strike-and-insert ruling the inserted sentence continued in EO 12334 until EO 12863 Sec. 3.3 revoked that parent; that is the end of the consequence, not of this order's own spent command.

research_rationale:
EO 12701 (55 FR 5953, signed 1990-02-14) deletes the second sentence of section 1 of EO 12334 and inserts "One member shall be designated by the President as Chairman." in its place. The command is self-executing and complete on signing, so the whole order (one clause) ended on 1990-02-14 by performance on issue. The inserted text survived inside EO 12334 until EO 12863 (signed 1993-09-13) revoked EO 12334 as amended in its Sec. 3.3; EO 12863 does not name EO 12701, so it is a parent-end event and not this order's end. The bounded searches (U.S. Code, eCFR, Federal Register disposition notes) found no other later instrument that names EO 12701.

This follows the strike-and-insert ruling: the amendment continues in the parent until the parent ends.
